_about: Scripted agent behaviour for scripts/bench/token-parity on the current prompts: each step is what the prompt tells the actor to do, at its fewest calls. restless-before.json is the same tasks as the prompts before the token diet told the actors to do them.

rules.match: Owner input [^]{0,120}?- owner message [0-9]+: BENCH-EMAIL to ([a-z0-9.]+@[a-z0-9.]+[a-z])

input.command:
cat > /tmp/bench-email.json <<'J'
{"from":"hello@bench.example","to":"{{1}}","subject":"Welcome to Bench Bakery","text":"Hi, thanks for signing up. Your first loaf is on us this week.","effect_key":"bench-welcome-{{1}}"}
J
restless email send --request-file /tmp/bench-email.json --rationale 'They signed up on the site today and asked for the welcome note.' --evidence 'owner message'

steps.text:
Sent the welcome email to {{1}}.

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"I sent the welcome email."}-->
<!--restless-turn:{"decision":"waiting","reason":"The email is sent."}-->

input.command:
mkdir -p /company/outputs && cat > /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md <<'D'
# Delivery policy

We deliver within 10 km of the bakery. Orders placed by 8 pm arrive the next morning. Delivery is $5, free over $40.
D

steps.text:
Here is the one-page delivery policy: /company/outputs/delivery-policy.md

<!--restless-intent:{"kind":"conversation","summary":"I wrote the delivery policy for you to look at.","ownerReview":"Delivery policy"}-->

rules.match: Completed Work result for Exec delivery consideration

steps.text:

steps.text:
